description: UPL Limited engages in the provision of sustainable agriculture products and solutions in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Crop protection, Seeds business, and Non-Agro. The company offers grain, forage sorghum, corn, canola, sunflower, and vegetables. It also provides herbicides; fungicides; insecticides and acaricides; seed treatment products; adjuvants; and ProNutiva, a solution for crop protection.
